audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Levels 3, 4-5 and First item to Shen while whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] on the same page say those stages are yours; packet.levelChart also says Urgot for rows 0-5.
audit.why: Both writable layers already agree with each other, and the already-written mirror (shen vs urgot) deliberately left the chart alone, so flipping here would create a mirror disagreement instead of fixing one. Flagged rather than guessed.
audit.corrected: No chart edit proposed — question raised for the user. Chart left as Urgot / Skill / Shen / Shen / Urgot / Shen / Shen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 is written around a 25% execute number and the Stand United window is described only as him leaving lane.
audit.why: Riot's Fear Beyond Death text gives an unnumbered threshold. Stand United is 200/180/160s and is a channel, so the level-6 spike is not just his absence — it is your ability to deny the channel.
audit.corrected: Level 6: below Fear Beyond Death's threshold he dies; and Stand United on a 200s cooldown at rank 1 is deniable, not just punishable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shen's Q is called 'Vorpal Blade' in three places — that is his retired ability name; and the page never states that Stand United is interruptible.
audit.why: Riot's kit lists Twilight Assault (Q), Spirit's Refuge (W), Shadow Dash (E, 18/16/14/12/10s, 150 mana), Stand United (R, channel flag). Disdain and Fear Beyond Death both apply hard CC, which cancels a channel. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities, so your Q and R still land through it.
audit.corrected: Twilight Assault is the Q. Stand United is a channel — Disdain or Fear Beyond Death cancels it and strands his ally. Spirit's Refuge blocks autos, not your spells. Shadow Dash's 18s at rank 1 is your trade window.

edits.before: W Purge shredding beats his single-hit Vorpal Blade in level-2 trades.
edits.after: W Purge shredding beats his single-hit Twilight Assault in level-2 trades.

edits.before: With Q Corrosive Charge plus W Purge you shred Shen through his passive shield; his Vorpal Blade (Q) sword only hits once per proc, so he can't trade the raw DPS you push out.
edits.after: With Q Corrosive Charge plus W Purge you shred Shen through Ki Barrier; Twilight Assault (Q) only lands once per recall, and Spirit's Refuge blocks autos, never your spells.

edits.before: You win the opening exchanges: Q Corrosive Charge plus W Purge out-DPS Shen's single-hit Vorpal Blade, and his passive shield gets chewed through fast, so trade aggressively at 1-3.
edits.after: You win the opening exchanges: Q Corrosive Charge plus W Purge out-DPS Shen's single-hit Twilight Assault, and Ki Barrier gets chewed through fast, so trade hard at levels 1-3.

edits.before: Your R Fear Beyond Death punishes Shen once you've chunked him; his ult Stand United is global so he'll often ping to save an ally, meaning if he leaves for a TP-style shield you get a free plate and shove.
edits.after: Stand United is a channel — Disdain or Fear Beyond Death cancels it outright, so watch for the cast and interrupt him. If he does escape to save an ally, take the free plate and shove the wave in.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash (Taunt): matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Shen Shadow Dash: Dashes in a line, taunting all enemies hit — his engage CC. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1 and 150 mana — the longest gap in his kit, so trade inside it. - Stand United: a channel; your Disdain or Fear Beyond Death cancels it and strands his ally.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 — that gap is your whole trade window.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Shen is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death online — under its threshold Shen dies, and it cancels Stand United. Trade him to half, then threaten.

edits.before: Late game your R is a pick machine: any frontliner dropped under 25% dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Shen carry threat: 7/10 — end the game before he cashes it.
edits.after: Late game your R is a pick machine: anyone dropped under its threshold dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Shen carry threat: 7/10 — end before he cashes it.

notes: packet suspectName on wants.foe[1] ('Use Stand United') is a false positive — Stand United is the correct R name. The genuine name error was 'Vorpal Blade' for Shen's Q, which is his retired name; the live ability is Twilight Assault, and it appeared in whys[1], spikes[0].text and early. Note Twilight Assault deals damage based on the target's max health, so building raw health against Shen has a cost — no field had room to state it without displacing a higher-value edit.
